description.narrative: Sierra Leone Threshold - Power Sector Reform Project - Institutional Strengthening Activity: This Activity will strengthen the capacity of key sector institutions to develop system plans, improve integrated system planning and interface with EWRC and comply with regulatory requirements. Grant funding will support the development of actionable, foundational sector studies, such as an industrial load assessment and an integrated investment master plan. If an integrated master plan and framework for soliciting independent power producers is adopted, conditional funding may also be available under this activity for project preparatory studies required to identify and prepare a viable independent power producer transaction to bring to market.

usg:usg-activity.usg:purpose-statement: Sierra Leone Threshold - Power Sector Reform Project - Institutional Strengthening Activity: This Activity will strengthen the capacity of key sector institutions to develop system plans, improve integrated system planning and interface with EWRC and comply with regulatory requirements. Grant funding will support the development of actionable, foundational sector studies, such as an industrial load assessment and an integrated investment master plan. If an integrated master plan and framework for soliciting independent power producers is adopted, conditional funding may also be available under this activity for project preparatory studies required to identify and prepare a viable independent power producer transaction to bring to market.
